title.narrative: PPG Phase of Law Enforcement for Sustainable Viable Ecosystems and Biodiversity Resilience through Multi-sectors Engagement (LEVERAGE) - PIMS 9613

description.narrative: I. BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE INITIATION PLAN/GEF PPGObjective & Final OutputsThe objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project entitled ‘Law Enforcement for Sustainable Viable Ecosystems and Biodiversity Resilience Through Multi Sectors Engagement (LEVERAGE)’. This is a child (national) project of the GEF Wildlife Conservation for Development Integrated Programme (WCD-IP). As described in the child project concept note, this project aims to strengthen collaborative and integrated law enforcement with multi-level stakeholder engagement for protecting biodiversity loss by incorporating positive behavioral change toward wildlife conservation and human health both men and women. The project is designed to strengthen law enforcement on wildlife crime to leverage benefits for biodiversity conservation and human health. The collective efforts of actors will reduce Illegal and High-Risk Wildlife Trade as a key driver of species loss and risk of pandemics. Simultaneously, it will address Human-Wildlife Coexistence issues through a multi-stakeholder and collaborative action approach. Application of technology and an innovative approach will be fostered. With GEF investment, the full-size project will improve management effectiveness of more than 600,000 ha of terrestrial protected areas, avoiding emissions from Agriculture, Forestry, and Other Land Use (indirect) - AFOLU sector approx. 23 million metric tons of CO2e over 20 years, benefiting 4,000 people including 1,200 women. Four project components and indicative outcomes and outputs are proposed to achieve the project objective:Component 1. Enabling Law Enforcement Ecosystems Outcome 1. Enhanced policy, regulatory framework and the governance for integrated wildlife-related law enforcement.Planned Outputs:1.1 Three policies recommendation on governance, policy and regulatory frameworks to strengthen law enforcement ecosystems.1.2.
